items.text: Bryan Adams's "(Everything I Do) I Do It for You" spent seven weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, the longest-running number-one single of 1991.
items.question: Where were you living when "(Everything I Do) I Do It for You" was on the radio, and was it anyone's special song?
items.source_quote: This is a list of the U.S. Billboard magazine Hot 100 number-ones of 1991. The longest running number-one single of 1991 is "(Everything I Do) I Do It for You" by Bryan Adams, which attained seven weeks at number-one.

items.text: The Super Nintendo Entertainment System was first released in the United States on August 23, 1991.
items.question: Who in your house played the Super Nintendo, and which game do you remember hearing from the next room?
items.source_quote: August 23 – The Super Nintendo Entertainment System is first released in the United States.

items.text: The sitcom Home Improvement premiered on ABC on September 17, 1991.
items.question: Who did you watch Home Improvement with, and who in your family was the Tim Taylor of the house?
items.source_quote: September 17 – Home Improvement premieres on ABC.

items.text: The Chicago Bulls won their first NBA championship by defeating the Los Angeles Lakers on June 12, 1991.
items.question: Where were you when the Bulls won their first championship, and who were you watching with?
items.source_quote: June 12 – The Chicago Bulls win their first NBA championship by defeating the Los Angeles Lakers.
